clusters.title: Enhanced AI provider configuration and authentication
clusters.summary: Users want more flexible options for connecting to AI model providers, including support for multiple provider profiles, API key authentication for servers like vLLM, and the ability to connect to endpoints with self-signed SSL/TLS certificates. These enhancements would enable integration with a wider variety of AI services and deployment scenarios.
clusters.representative_need: Add configuration option to allow connections to self-signed SSL/TLS certificate endpoints
sample_titles: Add configuration option to allow connections to self-signed SSL/TLS certificate endpoints
Support API key authentication for vllm server connections
Support multiple provider profiles per AI service and GitHub Copilot as an AI model provider

clusters.title: Fix UI rendering and interaction bugs
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing multiple UI rendering failures where content appears blank white, dropdowns don't expand when clicked, and the editor fails to render properly on startup or when opening folders. These issues prevent users from effectively interacting with and using the editor interface.
clusters.representative_need: Fix UI rendering issue where editor content becomes blank white when opening a folder
sample_titles: Fix UI rendering issue where editor content becomes blank white when opening a folder
Fix blank startup page display where the editor fails to render content
Fix model selection dropdown not expanding when clicked

clusters.title: Expand AI Provider Integration and Capabilities
clusters.summary: Users want to add support for new AI providers including LLaMa, Mistral, nano-gpt.com, kimi 2k, Claude Code, and automatic OpenRouter free tier fetching. They also want internet search and web scraping capabilities for AI models, along with fixes for existing AI features like file search and Unicode character handling.
clusters.representative_need: Add Claude Code subscription authentication and integration
sample_titles: Add Claude Code subscription authentication and integration
Add LLaMa model support as an AI provider
Add automatic fetching of OpenRouter free tier models

clusters.title: MCP Server Integration Fixes and Features
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing issues with MCP (Model Context Protocol) server connectivity, tool invocation with local LLMs, and SSE-based server support for decorated Python functions. They also want new capabilities like dynamic LLM model switching via API hooks and prompt inspection through request proxying. These issues collectively indicate a need for improved MCP integration robustness and extended functionality.
clusters.representative_need: Add API hook for MCP servers to dynamically switch session's LLM model
sample_titles: Add API hook for MCP servers to dynamically switch session's LLM model
Add prompt inspection/analysis capability through LLM request proxying
Fix MCP server connection errors preventing servers from connecting

clusters.title: Critical Bug Fixes for Core Functionality
clusters.summary: Users are reporting multiple bugs that need to be addressed to ensure the application works correctly. These include agent output formatting problems, security vulnerabilities in dependencies, path handling issues on Windows systems, and bundling errors with the Excalidraw integration. Fixing these issues will improve application reliability and developer experience.
sample_titles: Fix agent output formatting issues
Fix duplicate identifier error when bundling Excalidraw integration
Fix path handling in tool calls to work correctly on Windows

clusters.title: Build environment and tooling configuration
clusters.summary: Users need proper build environment setup for smooth development workflows. This includes adding support for new IDE versions like Visual Studio 2026 and resolving PATH issues that prevent tools like tailwindcss from being accessible during builds.
clusters.representative_need: Add support for Visual Studio 2026 in build configuration
sample_titles: Add support for Visual Studio 2026 in build configuration
Fix build failure due to missing tailwindcss command in PATH

clusters.title: Enhanced AI provider and model configuration options
clusters.summary: Users want more flexibility to customize their AI integration experience. This includes UI customization options like hiding floating widgets, configurable provider endpoints for custom proxies, per-model routing support for providers like OpenRouter, and the ability to manage custom model tags without modifying core files. These features would give users greater control over their AI setup and reduce the need for manual code modifications.
clusters.representative_need: Add OpenRouter provider routing configuration support per model
sample_titles: Add OpenRouter provider routing configuration support per model
Add setting option to hide floating widget
Add support for configurable/custom model tags to allow users to add, update, or remove AI models without modifying core editor files

clusters.title: Improve IDE interface controls and interactions
clusters.summary: Users want improvements to the IDE interface, including direct numeric input for reasoning budget settings, better popup menu positioning that doesn't interfere with text selection, browser-based IDE support for Void Agent settings, and expanded model support for qwen3-coder in file editing. These changes aim to enhance usability and functionality of the development environment.
clusters.representative_need: Add direct numeric input field for reasoning budget alongside the slider interface
sample_titles: Add direct numeric input field for reasoning budget alongside the slider interface
Fix edit file functionality to support qwen3-coder model
Fix inline popup menu positioning to not cover text selection or interrupt text selection behavior

clusters.title: Chat Panel UI Enhancements and Bug Fixes
clusters.summary: Users want improvements to the chat panel interface, including fixing a CSS bug where file drag-and-drop overlays fail to display due to missing positioning. Additionally, they want new UI features like parallel tool calling, web search integration, image attachments, thinking process visualization, tool call pending animations, and improved search functionality.
clusters.representative_need: Add parallel tool calling, web search tool, image attachments, thinking process display, tool call pending animation, and regex search improvements
sample_titles: Add parallel tool calling, web search tool, image attachments, thinking process display, tool call pending animation, and regex search improvements
Fix file drag-and-drop overlay not displaying in chat panel due to missing CSS position: relative

clusters.title: Fix Gemini API integration bugs
clusters.summary: Users are experiencing bugs in the Gemini API integration including broken request handling when proxying through OpenAI-compatible endpoints with specific settings, and invalid function name generation when .voidrules is empty. These issues prevent proper functionality in AI provider integrations.
clusters.representative_need: Fix invalid function name generation in Gemini API integration when .voidrules is empty
sample_titles: Fix invalid function name generation in Gemini API integration when .voidrules is empty
Fix request handling for OpenAI-compatible endpoints that proxy to Gemini when using 'supportsSystemMessage' and 'specialToolFormat' settings

clusters.title: LLM Provider Configuration and Model Support
clusters.summary: Users need improved support and configuration options for various LLM providers including Gemini, GPT-OSS, and LM Studio. These issues involve fixing model selection, supporting non-standard model tags, and enabling file access for local models. This improves flexibility for users working with different LLM ecosystems.
clusters.representative_need: Add support for non-standard GPT-OSS model tags
sample_titles: Add support for non-standard GPT-OSS model tags
Fix Gemini model configuration to use available models
Fix local LLM file access via LM Studio provider
